Consultant creates rough sketch with dimensions; identifies potential challenges (plumbing relocation, structural issues); discusses budget alignment; promises design proposal within 5 business days

steps.activity: Project Consultant performs detailed material take-off from approved design: tile sqm, paint liters, lumber board feet, pipe meters, wire meters, fixture counts, accessory quantities

System validates quantities against standard waste factors; checks inventory availability at nearest store/DC; identifies lead-time items (special order, import); generates material specification sheet

Automation Opportunity: - Pricing auto-computed from the cost + margin target; settlement auto-reconciled with discrepancy-flagging; invoice auto-generated from the POD/delivery record

steps.activity: Project Consultant prices all materials at trade/project price per VS-11; includes delivery, installation (if BuildRight-managed), waste allowance; generates comprehensive project quotation
Finance reviews project margin: material cost vs. project price; ensures minimum margin threshold met; approves or requests pricing adjustment; quotation valid for 30 days
